title: Weighted-incidence generator defect bridge for the exact R-525 comparison
question: For the unchanged PAH-001 generator and the exact R-525 maximal-prefix comparison candidate, what source-authorized root-level fields are sufficient to turn R-529 energy compatibility into the R-537 generator residual required for compact-time correlations?
purpose: Separate the missing dynamic input into a gradient defect and an adjoint-divergence defect. The identity is a finite operator factorization; it does not construct a source-owned comparison map or claim PAH-OMC-020 convergence.

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 F_rho, its original PH/LK/AP/TR rates, labelled Gibbs laws, OMC-004 strip and external unaccelerated Markov time.
fixed_scope.comparison: Use only the R-525 maximal-prefix conditional-expectation candidate as a researcher-owned map; no source authorization is inferred.
fixed_scope.order: The preregistered j-to-infinity stationary passage at fixed n precedes the anchored n comparison; no diagonal or reversed limit is introduced.
fixed_scope.target: The exact R-512 minimal closed form and the R-537 common-core Duhamel transfer remain the target contracts, not established inputs.
fixed_scope.normalization: Original labelled stationary normalization; R-490 C_sw remains a domination input only.

factorization.source: Let B_n be the exact source root-incidence/gradient operator on its declared finite form core, W_n its original diagonal conductance weight, and K_n=B_n^* W_n B_n.
factorization.target: Let B_infty and W_infty denote the corresponding target objects on the R-512 common space, with K_infty=B_infty^* W_infty B_infty.
factorization.comparison: Let U_n be the R-525 conditional-expectation map and C_n a root-space transfer supplied only by a future source-owner packet.
factorization.exact_identity: K_infty U_n-U_n K_n=D_n B_n+B_infty^* W_infty G_n on the common finite core.
factorization.residual_bound: If the two displayed defect terms are defined on the evolved local core and their L2 norms are integrable, then ||(K_infty U_n-U_n K_n)f|| is bounded by ||D_n B_n f||+||B_infty^* W_infty G_n f||.

conditional_transfer.temporal_input: For u_n^g(s)=U_n S_n(s)v_n(g), define r_n^g(s)=(d/ds)u_n^g(s)+K_infty u_n^g(s) using the unchanged finite stationary semigroup after the registered j limit.
conditional_transfer.defect_envelope: A source-authorized C_n plus integrable bounds for D_n B_n S_n(s)v_n(g) and B_infty^*W_infty G_n S_n(s)v_n(g) yield R_n(g;T)=integral_0^T ||r_n^g(s)|| ds.
conditional_transfer.duhamel_consequence: R-537 then gives the compact-time correlation bound N_f[I_n(g)+R_n(g;T)]+I_n(f)||g||, provided its common-space, core, correlation identity and initial recovery fields also hold.
conditional_transfer.scope: This is an implication only; none of C_n, G_n, D_n, the common core, the correlation identity or their uniform n estimates is source-authorized in the current corpus.

required_owner_packet: Source-owner authorization of the exact R-525 U_n with its domain and target measure.
Hash-pinned source and target root-incidence operators B_n/B_infty and original conductance weights W_n/W_infty.
A root transfer C_n with exact multiplicity, partial-domain and terminal-square conventions.
A uniform local-core estimate for the gradient defect G_n and the divergence defect D_n, including the unbounded-rate domain.
An integrable anchored-n bound for both defect terms along the unchanged finite stationary evolution, plus R-537 initial recovery and correlation identity fields.

diagnostic_fixture.role: Exact rational matrix fixture for the algebra and for detecting omission of either defect; it is not a PAH carrier or estimate.

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only after a source-authorized packet supplies U_n, C_n, B/W data, both defect bounds, the common core and R-537 temporal fields, with primary, independent, hostile and Lean agreement.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only an exact unchanged-PAH contradiction to the factorization inputs qualifies; a missing owner packet or the finite fixture is not a no-go.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Use while any owner field is absent; retain the factorization identity as a reusable admission contract.

single_next_question: Can the source owner hash-pin C_n and both gradient/divergence defect estimates for the exact R-525 U_n on the unchanged PAH-001 form core, including terminal-square and unbounded-rate domains?
revisit_condition: Reopen only when those owner fields are supplied or an exact PAH-specific failure of the factorization domain is found; do not repeat static L2 fixtures or construct a new carrier.
